purpose: Review official Zhaodong cadastral/registration custodian and public government-service channels for safe anonymous parcel geometry and stable parcel identity.
assessment: Zhaodong Natural Resources Bureau is an evidenced local registry/cadastral custodian, and the official Suihua government directory lists a Zhaodong Real Estate Registration Center. The official material reviewed is organizational/procedural and does not expose a safe anonymous parcel-vector response, native parcel identity, CRS, or geometry.
registryAssessment: The official municipal bureau page assigns unified real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, registration-information platform management, and public geographic-information responsibilities to the local bureau. The Suihua government page lists the Zhaodong Real Estate Registration Center with a local service address and telephone. This establishes local registry presence, not open parcel-vector access.
